text:
redis Kubernetes manifest

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: redis-cart
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: redis
        resources:
          limits:
            memory: 256Mi
            cpu: 125m
          requests:
            cpu: 70m
            memory: 200Mi
        volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /data
          name: redis-data

Redis persistence and socket configuration:
When cart service experiences rapid session churn, appendonly fsync can saturate IOPS limits if redis-data volume exceeds disk throughput thresholds.
